title: FY 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP (AARO/ODNI joint)
doc_notes: This document is the Fiscal Year 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena produced by the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI), covering reporting from August 31, 2022, to April 30, 2023.
